taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-09, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 975.4 | 1.86 | 1.86
2 | 552.4 | 22.73 | 24.59
3 | 730.5 | 1.22 | 25.81
4 | 1710.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-09, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station T-09, Survey Area T**

The interpreted VES model at T-09 comprises four layers. Resistivity decreases from 975.4 ohm-m (Layer 1) to 552.4 ohm-m (Layer 2) over the first 1.86 m, then increases to 730.5 ohm-m (Layer 3) at 25.81 m depth, and rises further to 1710.8 ohm-m in the underlying Layer 4 (assumed infinite half-space).

Applying the standard three-layer letter convention: Layers 1-2-3 (975.4 > 552.4 < 730.5) yield an **H** segment, and Layers 2-3-4 (552.4 < 730.5 < 1710.8) yield an **A** segment. The correct curve-type designation is therefore **HA**, not the **AA** type recorded in the file. The on-file classification does not match the resistivity sequence and should be corrected before further interpretation or drilling planning proceeds.

{"curve_type_stated": "HA", "label_issue_flagged": true}
